user.title: Create a conditioned sensor
user.description: Choose the source and explicitly select only the conditioning behaviors to include.

data.name: Name override
data.enable_window: Process readings in a time window

data_description.name: Leave blank to derive the name from the source.
data_description.attribute: Leave blank to condition the source state.
data_description.enable_limits: Configure an optional minimum and/or maximum valid value.
data_description.enable_calibration: Correct readings using raw and corrected value pairs.
data_description.enable_rounding: Round the final output to a chosen number of decimal places.
data_description.enable_window: Collect all accepted readings during one period and publish either their mean or the latest reading when it ends.
data_description.unit_of_measurement: Leave blank to inherit it from a state-based source. Attribute-based sources do not inherit metadata.
data_description.device_class: Leave blank to inherit it from a state-based source.
data_description.state_class: Leave blank to inherit it from a state-based source.
data_description.icon: Leave blank to inherit it from a state-based source.
data_description.hide_source: Hide the source entity in Home Assistant after creating this conditioned sensor. Cannot be used when conditioning an attribute.
data_description.follow_source: When on, this sensor is unavailable or unknown whenever the source is. When off, the last value is kept, as the original Calibration integration did.
data_description.stale_after: Optional. Mark this sensor unavailable when the source has not reported (changed or re-reported the same value) for this long. Leave blank or zero to disable.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Signal Conditioner
reconfigure.description: Change the source, metadata overrides, and conditioning behaviors. Blank metadata fields inherit from a state-based source.

value_limits.title: Limit values
value_limits.description: Only the rules entered here are added. Choose whether out-of-range raw readings are rejected or pinned to the nearest limit.

data_description.minimum: Leave blank for no lower limit.
data_description.maximum: Leave blank for no upper limit.
data_description.mode: Reject drops the reading and keeps the value already in force. Clamp pins it to the limit, like Home Assistant's range filter.

calibration.title: Calibrate values
calibration.description: Enter raw and corrected value pairs, one pair per line.

rounding.title: Round output values
rounding.description: Round only the final conditioned value.

window.title: Process readings in a time window
window.description: Each accepted reading stays in force until the next one, across intervals. The sensor publishes once at the end of each interval.

data_description.duration: The same period controls both collection and publication.
data_description.output: Mean is time-weighted: each reading counts for as long as it was in force. Latest publishes the reading in force when the interval ends.

abort.already_configured: This Signal Conditioner helper is already configured.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The Signal Conditioner helper was reconfigured successfully.

missing_source.title: Signal Conditioner source entity is missing
missing_source.description: **{conditioner}** references **{source}**, but that entity is not present in Home Assistant or its entity registry. Check for a renamed or removed entity, then update the Signal Conditioner source in the integration configuration or YAML and reload it. The issue clears automatically when the reference is valid.

disabled_source.title: Signal Conditioner source entity is disabled
disabled_source.description: **{conditioner}** references **{source}**, but that entity is disabled in Home Assistant. Enable the source entity or choose a different source in the Signal Conditioner configuration or YAML. The issue clears automatically when the reference is valid.
